mentions.name: Ajqvue
mentions.description: Ajqvue is a long-running Java desktop application described as a Personal Database Desktop Application, with an upcoming release (v3.6) supporting PostgreSQL, MariaDB, SQLite, H2, Derby, and HyperSQL.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Ajqvue v3.6.

A 20yr old Java project that I have been working that I now call a
Personal Database Desktop Application. The new release in comming
in a week or two supporting PostgreSQL 18, MariaDB 12, SQLite, H2,
Derby, and HyperSQL.
